slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: “徒儿，为师要回上界找你师娘去了，你自己下山讨生活去吧。”
刚搬完一座山的秦关回到住处后发现了师父留给他的信。
“这老头准没好事！”
看完第一句后，秦关顿时有不好的预感。
“十二年前，为师一时大意，失手拍死了青州南家老祖，作为补偿，在他临终前私自把你卖给了他们南家，与他签了个婚约，所以你上门当姑爷去吧…”
看到这里，秦关嘴角忍不住抽搐，十二年前，那时候自己才四岁，就被师父卖了，亏他这么信任这老头，真是个无耻老贼…
倒插门，他这辈子都没想过自己会做人家的上门女婿，在他来看这是男人的耻辱，男人要顶天立地，怎可屈居人下吃软饭？
想到这秦关很无奈，是师父将他从死人堆里扒了出来，抚养他长大，还传授了一身本领，在他心里早就把师父当成了父亲。
父债子偿，天经地义。
这软饭他不吃也得吃啊…
秦关叹了口气继续往下看。
“混账东西，刚才是不是骂为师了？”
看到这句话秦关直接无语，活的都不知岁月几何的老妖怪了，还像个孩童一样，什么时候能成熟一点！
“那个塔你好好保管，它对你很重要，千万别弄丢了，弄丢了老夫保证锤死你！”
“另外哪天若真是闯了大祸，摆平不了，你就打开那个红色锦囊，或许能帮到你。”
“最后别抱怨为师把你卖了，为师是送你去享受生活，青州美女云集，以你现在的实力可以在那里为所欲为。”
读完师父的信，秦关拿起桌上的一个储物袋打了开来。
里面有一个红色锦囊，一份婚约书，还有一个黑色的小塔。
看到那个小黑塔，秦关眼神顿时一亮，好东西！
唰！
秦关刚把小黑塔拿在手里，那小黑塔突然化作一道玄光没入他的眉心之中。
秦关试着沟通，结果那黑塔鸟都不鸟他。
“有个性，我喜欢。”
秦关撇嘴一笑，没再管那个小黑塔，他知道像这等器物都是有自己思想的，需要慢慢培养感情。
半个月后，青州地界。
广阔的江面上，一艘渡船缓缓而行。
船上，站着一名俏美女子，女子一袭白衣，面如美玉，柳腰间一条金凤黄罗锦带，将她婀娜的身段勾勒的十分迷人。
“小姐退后！”
这时，一名青袍老者突然出现在女子前方，将她护在了身后。
“怎么了，徐老？”女子有些诧异。
青袍老者眸光看向远处，神情有些凝重道：“有一个不得了的家伙过来了！”
女子闻言有些惊讶，她还从来没见过徐老这么紧张过。
就在这时，平静的江面突然荡起密密波纹，下一刻，江面突然炸开了锅，无数条鱼儿似是受到了惊吓，纷纷跃出水面惊慌逃窜。
哗哗！
content_en:
"Disciple, my master is going back to the upper world to find your master's wife. You can go down the mountain to make a living on your own."
Qin Guan, who had just moved a mountain, returned to his residence and found the letter left by his master.
"This old man must be up to no good!"
After reading the first sentence, Qin Guan suddenly had a bad feeling.
"Twelve years ago, my master was careless and accidentally killed the ancestor of the Nan family in Qingzhou. As compensation, I sold you to the Nan family privately before his death and signed a marriage contract with him, so you can come and be my uncle..."
Seeing this, Qin Guan's mouth couldn't help but twitch. Twelve years ago, when he was only four years old, he was betrayed by his master. He trusted this old man so much. He was really a shameless old thief...
He knocked on the door upside down. He never thought in his life that he would be someone else's son-in-law. In his opinion, it was a shame for a man. If a man wants to stand upright, how can he be subordinate to others and eat soft food?
Thinking of Qin Guan, he felt helpless. It was his master who picked him out from the dead, raised him up, and taught him skills. He had already regarded his master as his father in his heart.
The father's debt must be repaid by the son, as it is only right.
He has to eat this soft rice even if he doesn’t want to eat it...
"Alas!"
Qin Guan sighed and continued to look down.
"You bastard, did you just call me a teacher?"
Qin Guan was speechless when he saw this sentence. He was an old monster who had no idea how many years he had been alive. He was still like a child. When would he become more mature?
"You should take good care of that tower. It is very important to you. Don't lose it. If you do, I will beat you to death!"
"Also, if one day we really get into big trouble and can't solve it, just open that red bag of tips. It might help you."
"Finally, don't complain that I sold you out. I sent you to enjoy life. Qingzhou is full of beauties. With your current strength, you can do whatever you want there."
Qinguan: "..."
After reading Master's letter, Qin Guan picked up a storage bag on the table and opened it.
Inside there is a red tip bag, a marriage contract, and a small black tower.
Seeing the little black tower, Qin Guan's eyes suddenly lit up, good stuff!
Uh-huh!
Qin Guang just took the small black tower in his hand, and the small black tower suddenly turned into a mysterious light and disappeared into his eyebrows.
Qin Guan tried to communicate, but the black tower didn't like him.
"Personal, I like it."
Qin Guan curled his lips and smiled, and ignored the little black tower. He knew that artifacts like these had their own thoughts and needed to slowly develop feelings.
Half a month later, the border of Qingzhou.
On the vast river, a ferry boat moved slowly.
On the boat, stood a pretty woman, dressed in white, with a face as beautiful as jade, and a golden phoenix and yellow brocade belt around her waist, which outlined her graceful figure very charmingly.
"Miss, back off!"
At this time, an old man in green robe suddenly appeared in front of the woman and protected her behind him.
"What's wrong, Mr. Xu?" The woman was a little surprised.
The old man in green robe looked into the distance and said with a serious expression: "There is an incredible guy coming!"
The woman was a little surprised when she heard this. She had never seen Mr. Xu so nervous before.
At this moment, dense ripples suddenly appeared on the calm river surface. The next moment, the river surface suddenly exploded. Countless fish seemed to be frightened and jumped out of the water and fled in panic.
Wow!
